To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
neural networks can systematically generalize to compositions of concepts when the training data is augmented to build semantic links.

we propose a new perspective on systematic generalization from a meaningful learning point of view, and we show that modern sequence-to-sequece models, including RNCs, CNNs and Transformers, can systematically generalize to compositions of novel concepts, following this perspective.
neural networks can systematically generalize to new compositions if they are provided with meaningful training data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: Can neural networks learn systematically? How can we make them learn systematically? What is the mechanism of data augmentation in systematic generalization?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, with meaningful learning, neural networks have the capacity of systematic generalization, but the current neural networks are not yet good enough at it.
the neural networks can systematically generalize to new concepts if the new concepts are linked to previously known knowledge.
neural networks are not inherently ineffective in systematic generalization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
neural networks can generalize systematically, and meaningful learning is a promising approach towards that direction.
neural networks can generalize to novel compositions, if the learning scheme is meaningful.
, given enough prior knowledge and semantic connections, modern neural networks are capable of systematic generalization.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, with proper learning schemes, neural networks can achieve systematic generalization, a key feature of human intelligence.
neural networks are not as incapable of systematic generalization as previously claimed.
, given the right learning mechanism, neural networks can generalize to novel compositions in a systematic way.
